name: Blackhoof Village
summary: Blackhoof Village is a fortified encampment belonging to the Grimtotem tribe, hidden within the northern bogs of Dustwallow Marsh. Hostile to both Horde and Alliance alike, the village serves as a staging ground for raiders menacing nearby travelers and holding captured Theramore soldiers.

sections.title: A Grimtotem Enclave in the Swamps
sections.body: Tucked away among the stagnant pools of northern Dustwallow Marsh, Blackhoof Village represents the dark reach of the Grimtotem tribe far from their ancestral crags in Thousand Needles. Unlike the peaceful tauren allied with the Horde, the Grimtotem here operate as ruthless opportunists. They prey upon supply lines between the Barrens and the coast, striking from the mist before vanishing back into their stockade. The encampment features rough wooden barricades and cages holding unfortunate Theramore guards snatched along the roads.

sections.title: Secrets of the Marsh
sections.body: The presence of the Grimtotem at Blackhoof Village is inextricably linked to regional turmoil, including the destruction of the Shady Rest Inn along the main road. Evidence gathered around the smoking ruins points directly toward Blackhoof raiders, revealing their active campaign to destabilize peace in Dustwallow and wipe out any settled presence that contests their dominance over the swamps.

faq.answer: The settlement is populated by the Grimtotem tribe, an aggressive and reclusive tauren clan known for hostility toward both the Alliance and the wider Horde.

faq.q: Why are there Theramore prisoners in the village?
faq.answer: Grimtotem raiders patrol the roads connecting Dustwallow Marsh and the Barrens, ambushing travelers and taking Theramore soldiers captive to secure their dominance over the northern swamplands.

faq.q: Are the Grimtotem in Blackhoof Village allied with the Horde?
faq.answer: No. While Cairne Bloodhoof maintains uneasy relations with Magatha Grimtotem in Thunder Bluff, the Grimtotem outposts across the world act independently, treating Horde and Alliance adventurers with equal hostility.

faq.q: What is the village's connection to the Shady Rest Inn?
faq.answer: Investigations into the burned remains of the Shady Rest Inn point to the Grimtotem of Blackhoof Village, revealing that raiders from this camp carried out the attack to drive out settlers.

angles.text: For Alliance forces based in Theramore, Blackhoof Village is a persistent threat housing captured city guards and harboring the culprits behind the destruction of local rest stops.
Honorable tauren find the Grimtotem at Blackhoof Village a bitter reminder of their clan's treachery and violent isolation from the rest of their kind.
